about_short_description.short_description: Thesis* is a Bitcoin venture studio funding and building decentralized products and protocols that enable personal empowerment.

product.name: Mezo
product.description: A Bitcoin-first blockchain designed as an economic layer to enable real yield and stablecoin access using BTC as the native asset.

product.name: Fold
product.description: A retail-focused platform enabling users to spend bitcoin in everyday transactions at major merchants.

product.name: tBTC
product.description: A decentralized, trust-minimized bridge that brings Bitcoin liquidity to Ethereum, Solana, Optimism, and other EVM-compatible networks.

product.name: Keep
product.description: A privacy layer for public blockchains that enables secure off-chain private data storage and interaction with smart contracts.

product.name: Taho
product.description: A community-owned, open-source Web3 wallet designed to provide users with data sovereignty and permissionless access to their digital assets and identity.

product.name: Embody
product.description: A comprehensive, privacy-focused menstrual cycle tracking app that helps users understand and optimize their physical and mental health through detailed symptom tracking.
